claims.claim: Migration RUN inspection accepts simple RUN documents and REMEDIATION documents using execution.run, while rejecting malformed, unknown, ambiguous, or conflicting RUN state.

Recovery supersedes only a consumed, uncompleted v2 edge with no bound RUN, requires the separately activated exact target, and accepts only the bound TASK revision or an explicitly supplied newer revision of the same TASK on clean fast-forward main with unchanged legacy pin and authority identities. Exact replay is idempotent.

Recovery serializes against old-target consumption, leaves the old edge active while replacement evidence is staged, and changes authority only at the atomic supersession link. History inspection binds both sides and rejects conflicting linkage.

The replacement target uses existing consumed and terminal reconciliation and ordinary exact TASK admission. Completed state remains generation-exact; the BP-9 document requires the first downstream pin to match the activated bootstrap consumer target and later movement to use migrate-primary.

The commit changes only the three TASK-authorized paths. It leaves the source-bootstrap activation SHA, historical bootstrap-primary entry point, frozen Kernel, roadmap state, and Runtime terminal authority unchanged; no Executor-owned implementation work remains.
